newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Girl's body to be returned to Morocco from Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Girl's body to be returned to Morocco from Belgium.

text.p: The body of Moroccan-born Loubna Benaissa, found in a trunk under a Brussels garage, will be returned to Tangiers, northern Morocco on Saturday night for burial, the Belgium embassy said on Friday.
"Ambassador Marc Van Rysseleerghe is expected to attend the arrival on Saturday, and the funeral," a spokeswoman from the embassy said.
Neither the embassy nor consulate in Tangiers had details of when or exactly where the girl's funeral would take place. It was expected to be on Sunday.
The plane bringing the body of Loubna, who disappeared agaed nine in August 1992, was due at Tangiers airport at 7.25 p.m. (1925 GMT), the consulate said.
"The family comes from Tangiers," a spokesman added.
A convicted violent child molester, Patrick Derochette, was charged on Thursday with abduction, rape of a child under 10 years of age and illegal imprisonment leading to death.
Loubna is the third child to have been found dead within six months in Belgium, already under shock from a paedophile scandal.
